name: ffy-visual-audit
description: Headless render-and-check visual QA for feelfullyyou.com. Loads live pages in a real browser and inspects the RENDERED DOM (getComputedStyle/getBoundingClientRect), the same technique as check-contrast.js one level up, extended to more bug classes: broken images, unfilled image containers, wrong footer/brand color, oversized image bands, invisible-on-background buttons, text overflow.
